standard.coverage: Employers with FOUR OR MORE employees, excluding family members (820 ILCS 105/3(d)).
standard.note: Final step of SB 1 (2019). No escalator -- Illinois is flat at $15.00 until the legislature acts.

tipped.note: 820 ILCS 105/4(c) caps the tip credit at 40% of the minimum wage, so the cash wage is 60% -- $9.00. Chicago is separately phasing its tip credit out entirely; see local/IL-local-2026.json.

variants.label: Employees under 18 working fewer than 650 hours in a calendar year
variants.test: Under 18 AND fewer than 650 hours worked for the employer in the calendar year. Crossing 650 hours moves the employee to the full $15.00 for the rest of the year.
variants.note: 820 ILCS 105/4(a)(2). A genuine hours-tracking obligation, not just an age test.

knownGaps: Chicago and suburban Cook County set higher local rates on a July 1 cycle -- see local/IL-local-2026.json.
